comment: Verified corporate actions (splits/bonuses/demergers) applied as backward OHLC adjustments by services/market_data/corporate_actions.py. Add entries ONLY from a named, verified source (subscription feed, corporate-action data provider, or manual review of exchange announcements). Format: {"symbol": "RELIANCE", "event_type": "split"|"bonus"|"demerger"|"reverse_split", "effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "ratio": <old-shares-per-new for split, e.g. 2.0 for a 2:1 split>, "note": "optional"}. Ships empty on purpose - nothing here invents adjustments.
